items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1963-03-29
items.q: like Inez Rapana and Lil Jim and then the Black Van and them were rough bass drum players

ctx.x: Has Perrier the music changed in your auction during the last thirty years?

Yeah, yeah, yes, it did a little, because they had better bass drum players years ago. It looked like the bass drum players was different. In fact, they had more of them, and more brass bands. That's the biggest reason for them to chant that, like Inez Rapana and Lil Jim and then the Black Van and them were rough bass drum players, you know. Because you've got some good bass drum players now, but I mean you can count them out on one hand. Count them out on one hand. See, because you've got to play a few marches,…
But in other words, I mean the parade music hadn't changed any.
